name: soloist_connect
description: Spotify Connect on Volumio 3 via Spotify Soloist, playing through pcm.volumio (ALSA, no Pulse). Best effort build.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Best effort build for Volumio 3, offered as-is and tested by the community. Turns Volumio 3 into a Spotify Connect device using Spotify Soloist. Audio goes through pcm.volumio via an in-tree Pulse shim (0.2.11), with no PulseAudio or PipeWire. Requires your own Soloist API key from the Spotify for Developers dashboard. Unofficial and not affiliated with Spotify AB. The Soloist binary is downloaded from Spotify at install time and is not bundled. Installed from the GitHub release, not from the plugin store.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.9.7: The Pulse shim is 0.2.11: when Soloist stops supplying audio mid-track the daemon is told once the card has run dry, so it rebuffers and resumes instead of waiting forever; a card underrun is recovered and logged. 0.9.6: The Pulse shim is 0.2.10: played positions are kept in bytes, so a track's last frame is reported exactly and the next track starts on its own. 0.9.5: The Pulse shim is taken from its own release; every package is checked against it.
